policies.qual:
((EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM conversation_members cm
  WHERE ((cm.conversation_id = group_join_requests.conversation_id) AND (cm.user_id = auth.uid())))) OR (user_id = auth.uid()))

constraints: FOREIGN KEY (conversation_id) REFERENCES conversations(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
FOREIGN KEY (user_id) REFERENCES auth.users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
